mainEntity.name: What is a Shopify theme detector?

acceptedAnswer.text: A free tool that identifies the theme a Shopify store uses from its URL: theme name, maker, price and a link to the Theme Store. No extension and no login required.

mainEntity.name: How do I know which theme a Shopify store uses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paste the store URL into the tool and click Analyze. Shopify exposes the active theme in the store's code; the tool reads it and shows you the name, version and maker in a second.

mainEntity.name: Does the detector work if the merchant renamed the theme?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. On top of the name shown by the merchant, the tool reads the theme's base name (schema), which stays that of the original theme. So you can spot a Dawn or an Impulse even when it was renamed.

mainEntity.name: Can I see a competitor's theme price?

acceptedAnswer.text: When the theme comes from the official Theme Store, the tool shows its price and a direct link to its listing. For a custom or headless theme, there is no public price to display.
Yes, the Shopify theme detector is 100% free with no limit. Paste as many URLs as you want to analyze your competitors' themes.

mainEntity.name: Is the Shopify theme detector reliable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The tool reads the information Shopify publishes directly in the store's code, not an estimate. The theme's base name and Theme Store ID are exact; only the display name may have been customized by the merchant.

mainEntity.name: Can I detect a store's theme from my phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The tool runs in the browser, on mobile and desktop alike. Paste the URL, click Analyze, and you get the result without installing anything.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a theme's name and base name?

acceptedAnswer.text: The name is the label the merchant gave the theme, often renamed. The base name is the real original theme (Dawn, Impulse, Prestige). The tool shows both so you can identify the real theme even after a rename.

mainEntity.name: Does the tool work on every Shopify store?

acceptedAnswer.text: On the vast majority. Stores on a classic Liquid theme expose their theme and are detected. Headless stores (Hydrogen) do not expose a classic theme: the tool flags it clearly.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a Shopify theme is free or paid?

acceptedAnswer.text: When the theme comes from the Theme Store, the tool shows its price: Free for free themes (Dawn, Refresh) or the dollar amount for premium themes. A custom theme has no public price.

mainEntity.name: Can I install the same theme as a competitor?

acceptedAnswer.text: If it is a Theme Store theme, yes: click View on the Theme Store and install it on your store. A custom or headless theme, however, is not available for purchase.
